hints: How can a route have arrived at a given cell? There are only two possibilities, as in `grid-paths`.
From above or from the left - so the cheapest arrival here is this cell's toll plus the cheaper of those two.
Fill the grid top to bottom and left to right, so both are known when a cell is reached.
The first row and first column have only one way in each; treating a missing neighbour as infinitely expensive makes them fall out without a special case.
